about: A fresh, wholly held-out set for contradictions in other words (scripts/bench_knowledge.py contradictions --data fresh). Written on 2026-11-24 before any change of the remaining-items round to units, aliases or the subject test, and never used to choose a threshold, a rule or a prompt: it is run once with the code before the round and once with the code after it. 14 fictional subjects, 28 facts. Classes as in contradiction_paraphrase.json (restate, contradict, units, alias, property, subject, unnamed, unrelated) and four more: alias_stated = the subject called by a name that a stored statement itself gives it ('also known as', 'formerly', 'previously'); gold same or conflict; contained = a longer name that contains a stored subject's name and names something else ('Ashbury Cross, Vermont' beside 'Ashbury Cross'; gold none); iec = a data size in binary prefixes, or in megabytes that differ from the stored gigabytes by the binary factor (gold none: by the round's ruling, SI and IEC prefixes are never equated and a binary-factor difference is not decided). Units: every 'same' probe is within 1 % of the stored value after an exact conversion, every 'conflict' probe more than 5 % away. Two units probes are expected to stay undetected and count in recall: a value in 'pounds' (the value parser reads the word as a currency) and a number written in words.
